ko_hasuko.text: 목표요?

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: Goals?

turns.textJp:
ええ。せっかく練習をするのなら、
その成果をたくさんの人に見てもらいたいでしょう。 7

en_hasuko.speaker: Kozue
en_hasuko.text:
Yes. If we are going to practice, then naturally,
you would want many people to see the results.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 코즈에
ko_hasuko.text:
응. 모처럼 연습하는 거라면,
그 성과를 많은 사람에게 보여주고 싶잖아.

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: Yes. Since you’re going through the trouble of seriously practicing, you would want to be able to show everyone the fruits of your labor, wouldn’t you?

花帆.name: 花帆

turns.textJp: モチベーションを保つためにもね。 3

en_hasuko.speaker: Kozue
en_hasuko.text: It will help you keep your motivation, too.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 코즈에
ko_hasuko.text: 동기 부여를 위해서도 말이야.

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: It would be a great source of motivation, too.

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text: I see, that makes sense!

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text: 그렇군요, 확실히 그렇네요!

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: I get it. That makes a lot of sense!

turns.textJp:
では、あたしが卒業する直前の、
再来年の十二月ぐらいにライブをする、ということで……。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text:
Then how about we hold a live show around December two years from now,
right before I graduate...

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text:
그럼, 제가 졸업하기 직전인,
내후년 12월쯤에 라이브를 하는 걸로…….

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: So I’d say I should hold a performance right before I graduate, which would be around December, two years from now…

background.comment: 部室棟 部室 夕 着席構図
部室棟 部室 夕 着席構図

turns.textJp: お待ちなさい。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kozue
en_hasuko.text: Wait.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 코즈에
ko_hasuko.text: 잠깐만.

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: Hold it.

background.comment: 部室棟 部室 夕 着席構図
部室棟 部室 夕 着席構図

turns.textJp:
だってあたし、まだまだですから！
それぐらいいっぱい練習しなくっちゃ！

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text:
But I still have so far to go!
I need to practice a ton until then!

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text:
그치만 저, 아직 멀었으니까요!
그만큼 잔뜩 연습해야죠!

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: But I still have a long way to go! I have to practice at least that much!

background.comment: 部室棟 部室 夕 着席構図
部室棟 部室 夕 着席構図

turns.textJp: これはなかなか重症ね……。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kozue
en_hasuko.text: This is quite a serious case...

ko_hasuko.speaker: 코즈에
ko_hasuko.text: 이건 꽤 중증이네…….

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: This is going to take a lot of work…

background.comment: 部室棟 部室 夕 着席構図
部室棟 部室 夕 着席構図

turns.textJp: いい？日野下さん。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kozue
en_hasuko.text: Listen, Hinoshita-san.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 코즈에
ko_hasuko.text: 알겠니? 히노시타 양.

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: Alright, listen, Hinoshita-san.

background.comment: 部室棟 部室 夕 着席構図
部室棟 部室 夕 着席構図

turns.textJp: 最初から完成度の高いパフォーマンスを見せられたら、それは確かに理想的だわ。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kozue
en_hasuko.text: If you could show a polished performance right from the start, that would certainly be ideal.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 코즈에
ko_hasuko.text: 처음부터 완성도 높은 퍼포먼스를 보여줄 수 있다면, 그건 분명 이상적이겠지.

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: I understand that you would ideally perform perfectly right away.

background.comment: 部室棟 部室 夕 着席構図
部室棟 部室 夕 着席構図

turns.textJp: だけど、そのためにあなた自身の楽しさを我慢する必要はないの。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kozue
en_hasuko.text: But you do not need to sacrifice your own enjoyment for that.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 코즈에
ko_hasuko.text: 하지만, 그러기 위해서 너 자신의 즐거움을 참을 필요는 없어.

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: But there’s no reason to sacrifice what you enjoy for that.

花帆.name: 花帆
花帆.motionDescription: 着座手を膝の上で重ねる

turns.textJp: あたしの、楽しさ……。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text: My... enjoyment...

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text: 저의, 즐거움…….

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: What I enjoy…

background.comment: 部室棟 部室 夕 着席構図
部室棟 部室 夕 着席構図

turns.textJp:
一週間も連続でライブするぐらい好きなんだから。
ライブを二年も我慢するだなんて、本当は嫌でしょう？

en_hasuko.speaker: Kozue
en_hasuko.text:
You love live shows enough to perform for a whole week straight.
You would not truly want to hold yourself back from them for two years, would you?

ko_hasuko.speaker: 코즈에
ko_hasuko.text:
일주일이나 연속으로 라이브를 할 정도로 좋아하잖아.
라이브를 2년이나 참는 건, 사실 싫지?

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: I know you enjoyed performing so much that you performed every day for a week. I’m sure you really wouldn’t like having to hold off on performing for two years, right?

background.comment: 部室棟 部室 夕 着席構図

梢.name: 梢
梢.motionDescription: 頬に指を当てて首をかしげる

background.comment: 部室棟 部室 夕 着席構図

梢.name: 梢
梢.motionDescription: 頬に指を当てて首をかしげる

turns.textJp: ううう……はい、ライブしたいです……。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text: Uuu... yes, I want to do a live show...

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text: 우우우…… 네, 라이브하고 싶어요…….

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: Hnnngh… Yeah, I want to perform…

background.comment: 部室棟 部室 夕 着席構図
部室棟 部室 夕 着席構図

turns.textJp:
だったら、目標を定めて、
それまでにみっちりと練習をしましょう。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kozue
en_hasuko.text:
Then let us set a goal,
and practice hard until then.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 코즈에
ko_hasuko.text:
그렇다면, 목표를 정하고,
그때까지 빡세게 연습하자.

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: Then, we should set a goal for you and diligently practice until you meet that goal.

background.comment: 部室棟 部室 夕 着席構図
部室棟 部室 夕 着席構図

turns.textJp:
まだスクールアイドルになったばかりなんだもの。
今の時期は、やればやるほど得るものがあるわ。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kozue
en_hasuko.text:
You have only just become a school idol.
At this stage, the more you do, the more you gain.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 코즈에
ko_hasuko.text:
아직 스쿨 아이돌이 된 지 얼마 안 됐으니까.
지금 시기에는, 하면 할수록 얻는 게 있을 거야.

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: You’ve only just become a school idol, so the more work you put in now, the more benefit you’ll receive from it.

梢.motionDescription: 梢汎用2_髪の毛を触る（左）

turns.textJp: ほんの数日でも、見違えるほどにね。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kozue
en_hasuko.text: Even a few days can make you look like a different person.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 코즈에
ko_hasuko.text: 불과 며칠 만이라도, 몰라보게 달라질 정도로 말이야.

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: Even just a few days of practice can make a huge difference.

background.comment: 部室棟 部室 夕 着席構図

梢.name: 梢
梢.motionDescription: 梢汎用2_髪の毛を触る（左）

花帆.name: 花帆
花帆.motionDescription: 着座胸に手を置く（両手）

turns.textJp:
たった数日……。えっ、ライブの予定日ですか！？
早すぎませんか！？

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text:
Just a few days... Wait, is that when the live show is scheduled!?
Isn't that too soon!?

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text:
고작 며칠……. 엣, 라이브 예정일인가요!?
너무 빠른 거 아니에요!?

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: A few days… wait, you mean that’s when we’ll be performing next!? Isn’t that way too soon!?

background.comment: 部室棟 部室 夕 着席構図

花帆.name: 花帆
花帆.motionDescription: 着座胸に手を置く（両手）

background.comment: 部室棟 部室 夕 着席構図

turns.textJp:
しかもこれ、市の開いているライブイベントって、
規模大きくないですか！？

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text:
And this is a live event hosted by the city, right?
Isn't that kind of huge!?

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text:
게다가 이거, 시에서 여는 라이브 이벤트라니,
규모가 크지 않나요!?

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: And also, isn’t this an event in the city!? Isn’t this too big for me!?

background.comment: 部室棟 部室 夕 着席構図
部室棟 部室 夕 着席構図

turns.textJp:
市内から大勢のスクールアイドルが参加する催しよ。
たくさんの人に成果を見てもらう、いい機会ね。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kozue
en_hasuko.text:
It is an event where many school idols from around the city participate.
It is a good opportunity for many people to see the results of your work.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 코즈에
ko_hasuko.text:
시내에서 수많은 스쿨 아이돌이 참가하는 행사야.
많은 사람에게 성과를 보여줄, 좋은 기회지.

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: Because the event will be held in the city, many school idols will be participating. It would be a great place to show all those people the result of your efforts. I think it’s a great idea.

turns.textJp:
それは楽しそうですけど……！あ、でも！ほら！
蓮ノ空って学校外には出られないんですよね？

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text:
That does sound fun, but...! Oh, but! Look!
Hasunosora students can't leave campus, right?

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text:
그건 재밌을 것 같지만……! 아, 그래도! 보세요!
하스노소라는 학교 밖으로 못 나가는 거 아니었나요?

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: I mean, that does sound fun, but…! Oh, right! Look! We aren’t allowed to leave Hasunosora, right?

background.comment: 部室棟 部室 夕 着席構図

花帆.name: 花帆
花帆.motionDescription: 着座こめかみ辺りを掻く（人差し指で）

background.comment: 部室棟 部室 夕 着席構図

turns.textJp: だったらむりなんじゃないかなーって！

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text: So maybe it's impossible!

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text: 그렇다면 무리 아닐까~ 해서요!

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: So I guess there’s just no way we can join!

background.comment: 部室棟 部室 夕 着席構図
部室棟 部室 夕 着席構図

turns.textJp:
問題ないわ。
部活動として正式な理由があれば、ちゃんと外出許可も出ますから。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kozue
en_hasuko.text:
There is no problem.
If we have an official reason as a club activity, we can receive permission to go out.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 코즈에
ko_hasuko.text:
문제없어.
동아리 활동으로서 정식적인 이유가 있으면, 제대로 외출 허가도 나오니까.

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: That won’t be a problem. Because we’ll be doing official club activities, I’m sure we will be permitted to leave the school grounds.

background.comment: 部室棟 部室 夕 着席構図
部室棟 部室 夕 着席構図

turns.textJp:
この大会では、見る人の投票で順位もつくから。
出るからには、上位入賞……いえ。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kozue
en_hasuko.text:
At this competition, the audience votes to determine the rankings.
If we are going to participate, let us aim for a top placement... no.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 코즈에
ko_hasuko.text:
이 대회에서는, 보는 사람의 투표로 순위도 매겨지니까.
나가는 이상, 상위 입상…… 아니.

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: The competition will be judged based on poll results from the audience. Since we’ll be competing, let’s go for a high placement… no.

background.comment: 部室棟 部室 夕 着席構図
部室棟 部室 夕 着席構図

turns.textJp: 一位を目指して、がんばりましょう！

en_hasuko.speaker: Kozue
en_hasuko.text: Let us aim for first place and do our best!

ko_hasuko.speaker: 코즈에
ko_hasuko.text: 1위를 목표로, 힘내자!

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: Let’s aim for first place!

background.comment: 部室棟 部室 夕 着席構図
部室棟 部室 夕 着席構図

turns.textJp:
うううう……！わ、わかりました！
がんばりますってば！楽しいライブのために！おー！

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text:
Uuuuuh...! O-okay!
I'll do my best! For a fun live show! Yeah!

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text:
우우우우……! 아, 알겠습니다!
열심히 할게요! 즐거운 라이브를 위해서! 오~!

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
